# White Plumeria

Framework-agnostic design system. No Tailwind requirement. No model key in the static site.

## CSS contract
White Plumeria is a class stylesheet. Tailwind is not required and is not a dependency.
Use only a class that already appears in a component HTML example or class list below. Every class starts with wpl-.
Do not invent a class. Do not invent a Tailwind utility. Do not invent a package.
The HTML example is the source of truth. React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Solid, Preact, Qwik, Lit, Alpine, Marko, and Ember render those same classes.
Next, Nuxt, SvelteKit, SolidStart, Analog, and Qwik City are server hosts for an existing adapter. They are not packages.
Astro, Stimulus, Aurelia, Ripple, Stencil, VanJS, and LWC are not adapters in this repository.
Packages are not on npm. Do not invent an install command.

Colors come from the active theme. Set data-wpl-theme and data-wpl-scheme on an ancestor. Themes: white, ivory, ink, saffron, lagoon, blush. white is the default. Each theme has light and dark color tokens named --wpl-color-*.

## Components
- Accordion (accordion): Disclosure stack, single or multiple.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-accordion"><button class="wpl-accordion-trigger" aria-expanded="false">Fees</button></div>`
- Alert (alert): Inline status message that is part of the page.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-alert wpl-alert-warning" role="status"><p class="wpl-alert-title">Review needed</p></div>`
- Avatar (avatar): Image or initials, with an optional status dot.
  HTML: `<span class="wpl-avatar" role="img" aria-label="Laleh Karimi">LK</span>`
- Badge (badge): Compact status label.
  HTML: `<span class="wpl-badge wpl-badge-success">Paid</span>`
- Breadcrumb (breadcrumb): Hierarchical location.
  HTML: `<nav class="wpl-breadcrumb" aria-label="Breadcrumb"><ol><li><a href="/">Home</a></li></ol></nav>`
- Button (button): Action control with variant, appearance, size, and loading state.
  HTML: `<button class="wpl-btn wpl-btn-primary" type="button">Save changes</button>`
- ButtonGroup (button-group): Groups related buttons. Joined mode shares borders.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-btn-group" role="group" aria-label="Save options"><button class="wpl-btn wpl-btn-primary">Save</button></div>`
- Calendar (calendar): Month grid for Gregorian or Persian calendars.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-calendar"><div class="wpl-calendar-grid" role="grid"></div></div>`
- Card (card): Surface for a title, description, body, and actions.
  HTML: `<section class="wpl-card"><h2 class="wpl-card-title">Analytics</h2><p class="wpl-card-description">Overview of recent activity</p></section>`
- Carousel (carousel): Image and content slider with previous, next, captions, and slide tabs. This is not the range Slider.
  HTML: `<section class="wpl-carousel wpl-carousel-media" aria-roledescription="carousel" aria-label="Theme stills"><div class="wpl-carousel-viewport"><div class="wpl-carousel-track"><figure class="wpl-carousel-figure"><img class="wpl-carousel-image" src="/carousel/white.jpg" alt="White plumeria flowers on pale stone" /><figcaption class="wpl-carousel-caption"><strong>White</strong><span>The default palette.</span></figcaption></figure></div></div></section>`
- ChartContainer (chart-container): Accessible bar summary plus a data table. Not a charting engine.
  HTML: `<figure class="wpl-chart"><figcaption>Sample volume</figcaption></figure>`
- Checkbox (checkbox): Native checkbox with a visible label.
  HTML: `<label class="wpl-check"><input type="checkbox" name="email" /> Email me invoices</label>`
- Combobox (combobox): Filterable single-select listbox.
  HTML: `<!-- Combobox needs the framework or elements behavior. The class contract is wpl-combo, wpl-combo-control, wpl-combo-icon, and wpl-listbox. -->`
- CommandPalette (command-palette): Keyboard-first command list inside a dialog.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-command" role="dialog" aria-label="Command palette"></div>`
- Container (container): Centered content width.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-container wpl-container-md">Content</div>`
- ContextMenu (context-menu): Menu opened from contextmenu or Shift+F10, with one submenu level.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-menu" role="menu"><button class="wpl-menu-item" role="menuitem" aria-haspopup="menu">Export</button></div>`
- DataTable (data-table): Client-side sort, filter, and pagination. Narrow frames stack rows and keep a sort field.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-table-wrap"><table class="wpl-table"><caption>Sample transactions</caption></table></div>`
- DatePicker (date-picker): Text field plus calendar popover. Accepts ISO dates.
  HTML: `<label class="wpl-field">From <input class="wpl-input" type="date" value="2026-10-27" /></label>`
- DateRangePicker (date-range-picker): Start and end dates, with optional 24-hour times. A later choice is ordered first.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-date"><label>Start <input class="wpl-input" value="2026-10-12" /></label><label>End <input class="wpl-input" value="2026-10-20" /></label></div>`
- Dialog (dialog): Modal dialog with focus management and escape to close.
  HTML: `<dialog class="wpl-dialog"><h2 class="wpl-dialog-title">Discard draft?</h2></dialog>`
- Divider (divider): Horizontal rule, optionally with a label.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-divider-labeled" role="separator">Or</div>`
- Drawer (drawer): Side dialog for navigation or filters.
  HTML: `<dialog class="wpl-drawer"><h2 class="wpl-dialog-title">Filters</h2></dialog>`
- DropdownMenu (dropdown-menu): Menu button with keyboard navigation and one submenu level.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-menu" role="menu"><button class="wpl-menu-item" role="menuitem" aria-haspopup="menu">Theme</button></div>`
- EmptyState (empty-state): Explains an empty collection and offers the next action.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-empty"><h2 class="wpl-empty-title">No invoices</h2><p class="wpl-empty-description">Create the first invoice to see it here.</p></div>`
- FileUpload (file-upload): Local file selection with type and size checks. It does not upload.
  HTML: `<label class="wpl-file-drop">Statement PDF <input class="wpl-file-input" type="file" accept="application/pdf" /></label>`
- Flex (flex): Inline row with wrap and alignment options.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-flex wpl-flex-between"></div>`
- Footer (footer): Content info landmark.
  HTML: `<footer class="wpl-footer">MIT License</footer>`
- FormField (form-field): Connects label, control, hint, and error by id.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-field wpl-field-invalid"><label class="wpl-label" for="email">Email</label><input id="email" class="wpl-input" aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="email-error" /><p id="email-error" class="wpl-field-error" role="alert">Enter a valid email</p></div>`
- FormMessage (form-message): Hint or error text with the correct role.
  HTML: `<p class="wpl-field-error" role="alert">Amount must be positive.</p>`
- Grid (grid): Responsive 1 to 4 column grid. The column count follows the grid width, not the viewport.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-grid wpl-grid-3"></div>`
- IconButton (icon-button): Square button that requires an accessible name.
  HTML: `<button class="wpl-icon-btn wpl-btn-ghost" type="button" aria-label="Close"><svg class="wpl-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M7 7l10 10M17 7 7 17"/></svg></button>`
- Input (input): Single-line text field.
  HTML: `<input class="wpl-input" name="email" type="email" placeholder="ada@example.com" />`
- Kbd (kbd): Visual keyboard key. It does not register a shortcut.
  HTML: `<span class="wpl-kbd-group"><kbd class="wpl-kbd">Ctrl</kbd><kbd class="wpl-kbd">K</kbd></span>`
- Label (label): Form label associated by htmlFor.
  HTML: `<label class="wpl-label" for="email">Email</label>`
- Link (link): Text link. External links receive safe rel and target.
  HTML: `<a class="wpl-link" href="#install">Installation</a>`
- List (list): Stacked list of title, description, and optional trailing action.
  HTML: `<ul class="wpl-list"><li class="wpl-list-item">Invoice 104</li></ul>`
- Modal (modal): Dialog preset that is always modal.
  HTML: `<dialog class="wpl-dialog"><h2 class="wpl-dialog-title">Confirm</h2></dialog>`
- Navbar (navbar): Sticky header with a collapsible menu.
  HTML: `<header class="wpl-navbar"><a class="wpl-navbar-brand" href="/">White Plumeria</a></header>`
- NavigationMenu (navigation-menu): Horizontal list of links.
  HTML: `<ul class="wpl-nav-menu"><li><a class="wpl-nav-link" href="#start" aria-current="page">Start</a></li></ul>`
- Notification (notification): Persistent inline notice. Its tone follows the theme, and dismiss is optional.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-notification wpl-notification-success" role="status"><p class="wpl-toast-title">Saved</p><p class="wpl-toast-description">The sample stayed in this tab.</p></div>`
- NumberField (number-field): Numeric field with decrease and increase buttons. The value snaps to the step.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-field"><label class="wpl-label" for="guests">Guests</label><div class="wpl-number"><button class="wpl-number-step" type="button">−</button><input class="wpl-input" id="guests" name="guests" type="number" min="1" max="8" value="2" /><button class="wpl-number-step" type="button">+</button></div></div>`
- OtpField (otp-field): One-time-code field. It does not send or verify a code.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-otp" role="group" aria-label="Verification code"><input class="wpl-input wpl-otp-cell" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" aria-label="Character 1 of 6" /></div>`
- PageHeader (page-header): Title, description, and action row.
  HTML: `<header class="wpl-page-header"><h1 class="wpl-page-title">Invoices</h1></header>`
- Pagination (pagination): Page controls with a current page.
  HTML: `<nav class="wpl-pagination" aria-label="Pagination"><button class="wpl-page" aria-current="page">1</button></nav>`
- PasswordField (password-field): Password field with a visible label and a reveal toggle. It does not score strength.
  HTML: `<label class="wpl-label" for="password">Password</label><div class="wpl-password"><input id="password" class="wpl-input" type="password" name="password" autocomplete="current-password" /></div>`
- Popover (popover): Anchored non-modal panel.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-popover">Settles on the next business day.</div>`
- Progress (progress): Determinate or indeterminate progress.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-progress-track" role="progressbar" aria-label="Upload" aria-valuenow="40" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100"><span class="wpl-progress-bar" style="inline-size:40%"></span></div>`
- RadioGroup (radio-group): Named native radios with a legend.
  HTML: `<fieldset><legend>Plan</legend><label class="wpl-radio"><input type="radio" name="plan" value="annual" /> Annual</label></fieldset>`
- RangeSlider (range-slider): Two thumbs for a numeric start and end. A thumb stops at the other thumb.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-range" style="--wpl-range-start: 16%; --wpl-range-size: 48%"><span class="wpl-range-track"></span><span class="wpl-range-fill"></span><input class="wpl-range-input" type="range" min="0" max="500" value="80" aria-label="Price start" /><input class="wpl-range-input" type="range" min="0" max="500" value="320" aria-label="Price end" /></div>`
- Rating (rating): Star rating as a radio group. It does not submit a review by itself.
  HTML: `<fieldset class="wpl-rating"><legend>Workspace quality</legend><label><input type="radio" name="quality" value="4" checked /> 4 of 5</label></fieldset>`
- ResponsiveLayout (responsive-layout): Sidebar plus main. The sidebar stacks when this layout is narrower than 40rem.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-layout"><nav class="wpl-sidebar" aria-label="Docs"></nav><main class="wpl-layout-main"></main></div>`
- SearchInput (search-input): Search field with a clear button.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-search"><label class="wpl-label" for="q">Search docs</label><div class="wpl-search-control"><input id="q" class="wpl-input" type="search" /></div></div>`
- Select (select): Styled native select. Use Combobox for a custom listbox.
  HTML: `<select class="wpl-select" name="currency"><option value="eur">EUR</option></select>`
- Separator (separator): Orientation-aware non-text separator.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-separator wpl-separator-vertical" role="separator" aria-orientation="vertical"></div>`
- Sidebar (sidebar): Vertical navigation landmark.
  HTML: `<nav class="wpl-sidebar" aria-label="Docs"><a href="#button" aria-current="page">Button</a></nav>`
- Skeleton (skeleton): Placeholder block while content loads.
  HTML: `<span class="wpl-skeleton" style="width:12rem;height:1rem" aria-hidden="true"></span>`
- Slider (slider): Native range input with a visible value.
  HTML: `<label>Volume <input class="wpl-slider" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="40" /></label>`
- Spinner (spinner): Indeterminate progress indicator.
  HTML: `<span class="wpl-spinner" role="status" aria-label="Saving"></span>`
- SplitPane (split-pane): Two panes with a keyboard-resizable separator.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-split"><div class="wpl-split-pane">Notes</div><div class="wpl-split-separator" role="separator" aria-orientation="vertical"></div><div class="wpl-split-pane">Preview</div></div>`
- Stack (stack): Vertical stack with a gap token.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-stack wpl-stack-sm"></div>`
- StatCard (stat-card): Label, value, and hint. It does not invent numbers.
  HTML: `<article class="wpl-card wpl-stat"><p class="wpl-stat-label">Open invoices</p><p class="wpl-stat-value">12</p><p class="wpl-stat-hint">Sample data</p></article>`
- Steps (steps): Checkout or setup progress. Linear mode blocks future steps until the value moves forward.
  HTML: `<ol class="wpl-steps" aria-label="Checkout"><li class="wpl-step" data-state="current" aria-current="step"><span class="wpl-step-marker">1</span><span class="wpl-step-title">Account</span></li></ol>`
- Switch (switch): Boolean switch with role="switch".
  HTML: `<button class="wpl-switch" type="button" role="switch" aria-checked="false"><span class="wpl-switch-control"></span> Reduced motion</button>`
- Table (table): Semantic table wrapper with a caption.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-table-wrap"><table class="wpl-table"><caption>Sample rates</caption></table></div>`
- Tabs (tabs): Automatic-activation tabs.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-tablist" role="tablist"><button class="wpl-tab" role="tab" aria-selected="true">Overview</button></div>`
- Textarea (textarea): Multi-line text field.
  HTML: `<textarea class="wpl-textarea" name="note" rows="4"></textarea>`
- Timeline (timeline): Ordered events with time elements.
  HTML: `<ol class="wpl-timeline"><li class="wpl-timeline-item"><div><p class="wpl-timeline-title">Draft saved</p></div></li></ol>`
- Toast (toast): Transient message in a live region.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-toast-region" aria-live="polite"><div class="wpl-toast wpl-toast-success" role="status">Saved</div></div>`
- ToggleGroup (toggle-group): Joined buttons for one choice. Arrow keys follow reading direction. This is not RadioGroup.
  HTML: `<div class="wpl-field"><span class="wpl-label" id="appearance">Appearance</span><div class="wpl-toggle" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="appearance"><button type="button" class="wpl-toggle-item" role="radio" aria-checked="true">Light</button><button type="button" class="wpl-toggle-item" role="radio" aria-checked="false">Dark</button></div></div>`
- Tooltip (tooltip): Supplemental hint on hover and keyboard focus.
  HTML: `<span class="wpl-tooltip" role="tooltip">Copy token</span>`
- TreeView (tree-view): Expandable tree with arrow-key navigation.
  HTML: `<ul class="wpl-tree" role="tree"><li role="none"><button class="wpl-tree-row" role="treeitem">src</button></li></ul>`
- ValidationMessage (validation-message): Alias of FormMessage with tone="error".
  HTML: `<p class="wpl-field-error" role="alert">Amount must be positive.</p>`

AI tools may only name components from this list, and may only use the classes in these HTML examples.

## Limits
- Avatar: Broken images fall back to initials on the error event. There is no remote presence service.
- Button: xs is 1.75rem and is for dense toolbars, not the only target of a primary action.
- Button: appearance is ignored when variant is link.
- Calendar: Local timezone only. No time of day. Persian conversion is tested against Intl.
- Carousel: Does not autoplay.
- Carousel: Does not download or optimize images. Pass a src your app already serves.
- Carousel: The picture covers a 3:2 frame. The image file does not set the carousel height.
- Carousel: A pointer drag moves one slide. It is not a physics scroller.
- Carousel: The HTML class snapshot does not include the behavior.
- ChartContainer: No line, pie, zoom, or canvas chart. Children can replace the bar view, but the table remains.
- Combobox: Single select. Options are local. No virtualization and no async loader.
- CommandPalette: Filters the provided list only. No fuzzy scoring beyond substring and keywords.
- ContextMenu: Does not replace the browser menu for assistive tech that does not emit contextmenu.
- ContextMenu: One submenu level. Deeper items are not opened.
- DataTable: Client-side only. No virtualization and no server cursor mode in 0.1.0.
- DatePicker: Value is always a Gregorian ISO date so forms stay unambiguous. Persian display is a view, not a stored Jalali string. Use DateRangePicker for a start and end date.
- DateRangePicker: No seconds and no timezone name. Dates stay Gregorian ISO strings, not Jalali strings. The first open selection sets the start; the next sets the end. Same-day times are ordered too.
- Dialog: Open dialogs are activated after mount. SSR HTML does not call showModal.
- DropdownMenu: One submenu level. Deeper items are not opened.
- DropdownMenu: Typeahead matches a label prefix. Letters typed within half a second narrow it; the same letter cycles.
- FileUpload: Does not upload to a server. Rejected files are reported in the error list and are not executed.
- FormField: Context wiring is implemented in React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Solid, Preact, Qwik, Lit, Alpine, Marko, and Ember. HTML users set ids manually.
- Grid: Collapses to one column when the grid is narrower than 48rem. Three and four columns use two tracks from 48rem to 64rem. Not a masonry layout.
- Kbd: Visual only. Pair it with a real keydown listener in your application if the shortcut must work.
- Modal: This is a Dialog preset, not a second focus system.
- Navbar: The menu collapses at a 48rem viewport or a 36rem container. It is CSS, not a resize observer.
- NavigationMenu: No mega-menu panels in 0.1.0.
- Notification: Not a push-notification service and not a toast. The close button appears only when a dismiss handler is passed. Angular and Lit use the dismissable prop for that button.
- NumberField: Does not format currency or locale grouping inside the input. The stored value is a number.
- NumberField: An unfinished draft, such as a trailing decimal, is kept until blur, then snapped or restored.
- OtpField: Does not send or verify a code.
- OtpField: The value is left-packed. Typing past the current end appends.
- PasswordField: Does not score strength or talk to an identity provider.
- PasswordField: Reveal shows the value on screen.
- Popover: No hover-open mode. Use Tooltip for hover hints.
- RangeSlider: When the thumbs overlap, the pointer hits the end thumb. The start thumb stays reachable from the keyboard.
- RangeSlider: The HTML classes draw the track. Ordering the two values is done by the React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Solid, Preact, Qwik, Lit, Alpine, Marko, and Ember components.
- Rating: Does not submit a review by itself. Read the value from your form.
- Rating: max is clamped from 1 to 10.
- ResponsiveLayout: Collapse is a 40rem container query on the layout, not the viewport. The open flag only shows the sidebar while it is stacked.
- Select: Not a custom-styled popup. That is Combobox.
- Skeleton: Not a content layout detector. You size each placeholder.
- Slider: Single thumb only. Use RangeSlider for a start and end value.
- SplitPane: Horizontal split only. No nested persistence.
- StatCard: No sparkline and no live data source.
- Steps: Does not validate a form or persist progress. Move the value from your own Next control.
- Table: Static markup. Sorting and filtering are DataTable.
- Toast: Requires WhitePlumeriaProvider or ToastProvider. Auto-dismiss default is 5 seconds and is cancelled under reduced motion.
- ToggleGroup: One value. It does not select several items.
- ToggleGroup: Not a set of independent switches. Use Checkbox or Switch for that.
- ToggleGroup: Not a labeled radio list. Use RadioGroup when the choice should look like a radio.
- Tooltip: Not shown as the only path on touch. Delay is 400ms. Escape dismisses.
- TreeView: No drag and drop. No virtualization.
- ValidationMessage: Preset of FormMessage, not a second validation engine.
